title: Brand Marketing Intern, France
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 
The community you will join:
Airbnb is seeking a Brand Marketing Intern to join the French & BENELUX Marketing team for a six month internship starting March 15, 2027.
Join Airbnb’s Marketing team to help deliver inspiring, high-impact brand campaigns and partnerships sparking travel on Airbnb and supporting host community growth in France and the Netherlands. We have exciting projects coming up in 2027, including the third year of our partnership with the Tour de France & Tour de France Femmes, seasonal campaigns and the ongoing promotion of Airbnb Experiences and Services, which now complement our historical business of homes.
To help make these a success, we’re looking for a motivated intern who is eager to dive into real-world marketing, media, and partnership projects.
Internship dates: March 15 - September 15, 2027.
 
The difference you will make:
Supporting the operational execution of Local Programs & Partnerships
Act as a day-to-day point of contact for the media agency on campaign execution.
Help execute the creative strategy : 
Be the liaison with the internal creative teams and creative agency on the execution of high-quality, premium content
Ensure creative outputs are aligned with the overall campaign objectives and media plan requirements
Coordinate with the Community team to identify, source, and onboard hosts and listings participating in the campaign
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of the plan, including collecting internal clearances of selected listings through Legal and other relevant teams
Help with contracts and administrative follow-ups
Supervise production, attend shooting, manage schedules, timelines and logistics
Organise creative reviews and approvals by coordinating feedback loops while ensuring deadlines are met
Helping on the day-to-day execution of always-on campaigns for guests & hosts 
Participate in the creative & localization efforts for France:
Supporting on the localization of the assets in French jointly with the localization and copy writing teams, ensuring consumer and market relevance
Attend the recording sessions of spots 
Partnering with the media team to determine weekly TV/OTT media rotations in line with the approved strategy for the French market
Analyze creative and media performances, formulating future recommendations
Help execute the Audio strategy (Podcasts, Radio) for France 
Acting as a strategic partner to the Marketing team helping us go beyond our usual scope by bringing a fresh perspective to the table:
Market & Competitor Insights
Monitor competitors and market best practices in France, Belgium, and the Netherlands.
Identify emerging trends, new and up‑and‑coming platforms, and opportunities to differentiate Airbnb from the competition.
Process & Ways of Working
Support the team in streamlining existing processes to improve collaboration, clarity, and efficiency.
Help build or refine simple tools (trackers, templates, checklists) that make day-to-day execution smoother.
Measurement, Reporting & Learnings
Collect campaign results and key metrics from agencies and internal teams.
Consolidate data and insights into clear, structured post‑campaign reports.
Highlight key learnings and formulate actionable recommendations for future campaigns.
 
The intern experience:
As an intern, you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our incredible employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during the summer. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our product, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel. You can expect to:
Collaborate with multiple team members to achieve project milestones
Communicate with stakeholders across different teams to provide project updates
Seek and provide feedback throughout the internship
Actively participate in and contribute to the Marketing team and broader Airbnb community
 
Your expertise:
Preferred: End-of-studies internship
Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
French native & professional proficiency in English
Proven record of creative skills and attention to detail.
Prior experience in marketing, communications and/or PR (internship or student projects).
Sensitivity to creative, brand, and media environments.
Solid project management & communication skills: ability to manage multiple stakeholders and tasks, respect deadlines, and prioritize.
Strong analytical skills
Versatile, proactive, and “can-do” attitude.
Comfortable with the Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, Docs, Gmail).
 
Our commitment to inclusion & belonging:
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
How We'll Take Care of You:
The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future.  This role may also be eligible for benefits and Employee Travel Credits. 
France Annual Pay Range
€25.000 — €25.000 EUR
 
Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.
